verdict: Major revision is required before this can serve as a stable training curriculum. The guideposts are visibly represented and the hierarchy is structurally complete, but discovery noise has expanded the subject into document serialization, domain-specific physics, and numerical ODE solving; core analytical data preparation and experiment-design capabilities remain under-modeled; five sections fail mutual self-confidence; and 10 of 32 prerequisite edges fail the stated necessity or entry-delta contract.
blocking_findings: Coverage: c07.data-foundations claims transformation into analysis-ready data, but no leaf trains ordinary analytical wrangling such as filtering, recoding, type/date normalization, joins, reshaping, missing-value treatment, or derived variables. Schema extraction and serialization do not cover this capability, so the parent outcome and representative task are not contained by its children.

Coverage and hierarchy containment: c07.experiments-health.experimental-design promises randomization, outcome definition, and decision rules, but its leaves cover laboratory control validation and analysis of an already randomized A/B test. There is no child for assignment-unit choice, blocking or stratification, power and sample-size planning, exposure integrity, stopping rules, or multiplicity. The parent representative task therefore exercises capabilities absent from both children.

Subject containment: c07.data-foundations.structured-data.schema-mapping and .serialization are anchored by c07-d04, c07-d08, c07-d12, and c07-d16, whose central behavior is arbitrary document-to-schema conversion or format compliance rather than analysis or visualization. Narrow this branch to analytical data preparation, or route these tasks to structured-output/programming coverage.

Subject containment: c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims admits generic philosophy-of-science tasks such as c07-d11, while c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.scientific makes numerical integration, singular ODE handling, and dynamical stability central through c07-d15 and its representative probe. Claim calibration should be tied to empirical analyses, and scientific visualization should consume supplied or separately computed trajectories rather than train scientific computation itself.

Boundary: c07.data-foundations.eda.summaries explicitly includes group differences, while the entry probe for c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships merely compares the direction of a numeric difference between two categories from supplied group summaries. No decisive operation separates that task from grouped aggregation. The relationship entry should require an association, stratification, interaction, or artifact check that summaries alone cannot answer.

Generation: the entry probe for c07.probability-statistics.probability.updating calls the test perfectly reliable while also asking the learner to use supplied test rates. Literal perfect reliability makes a positive result trivial; nontrivial sensitivity and specificity make it imperfect. The probe therefore does not unambiguously isolate Bayesian updating.

Internal-node generation: c07.visualization-reporting requires a statistical chart, specialized scientific diagnostic, infographic, interactive dashboard, and report to support one decision. A typical operational dashboard has no trajectory or field diagnostic, while a phase-portrait analysis has no natural monitoring dashboard. This is forced co-occurrence rather than coherent cross-child synthesis and is too large to be a stable representative task.

Mutual self-confidence is blocking in c07.data-foundations.structured-data.serialization, c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics, c07.models-time.model-assessment.assumptions, c07.models-time.econometrics.identification, and c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.scientific; the counterexample pairs are detailed below.

Prerequisite continuity is blocking on 10 of the 32 declared edges. Several encode pipeline order even though dependent probes are handed the prerequisite product, two use domain-specific control validation as a proxy for unrelated causal-design knowledge, and two leave the entry probe requiring capabilities the prerequisite explicitly does not teach.
mutual_confidence_findings: c07.data-foundations.structured-data.serialization: mastery of serializing a nested record as well-formed XML does not predict constructing a reversible CSV representation with quoting, null conventions, and an explicit flattening scheme. Tree syntax and lossless tabular flattening have different central correctness contracts; split hierarchical serialization from tabular serialization or constrain the supported representation.

c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics: mastery of a paired before-and-after biomarker analysis does not predict analysis of right-censored follow-up using risk sets, survival curves, or proportional-hazards assumptions. These are distinct statistical method families; separate longitudinal/paired outcomes from survival and event-time analysis, with further grouping only where transfer is demonstrated.

c07.models-time.model-assessment.assumptions: c07-d01 asks for nuclear-physics reasoning about mean-field evolution after neutrino-induced knockout, whereas c07-d05 asks for phonon mean-free-path and boundary-regime reasoning in nanowires. Mastery of either domain-specific mechanism does not predict the other. Supply the relevant domain model and make residual-to-assumption reasoning central, or route specialized scientific knowledge outside C07.

c07.models-time.econometrics.identification: mastery of a difference-in-differences task using parallel trends and event-study diagnostics does not predict an instrumental-variables task requiring relevance, exclusion, monotonicity, and 2SLS interpretation; neither reliably predicts regression-discontinuity continuity and manipulation checks. Split identification designs or create narrower sections organized by a genuinely shared design contract.

c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.scientific: mastery of numerically integrating a nonlinear ODE and interpreting a phase portrait does not predict visualizing a gridded scalar/vector field or designing a parameter-sweep and sensitivity view. The required computation, domain semantics, and visual correctness checks differ. Separate dynamical-systems visualization from field/simulation diagnostics, or narrow the section to visualization of supplied scientific results.
continuity_findings: All 32 edges were checked. The following 22 have a defensible minimal entry delta and a representative task that materially uses the prerequisite: probability.events -> probability.expectation; eda.summaries -> inference.estimation; inference.estimation -> inference.hypothesis-tests; eda.summaries -> inference.moment-bounds; probability.events -> inference.moment-bounds; inference.hypothesis-tests -> experimental-design.ab-analysis; inference.hypothesis-tests -> population-health.biostatistics; probability.events -> population-health.epidemiology; eda.summaries -> population-health.epidemiology; eda.relationships -> model-assessment.assumptions; eda.relationships -> econometrics.estimation; inference.estimation -> econometrics.estimation; econometrics.estimation -> econometrics.identification; eda.relationships -> forecasting.temporal-structure; forecasting.temporal-structure -> forecasting.evaluation; eda -> visualization.chart-design; visualization.chart-design -> visualization.infographic; model-assessment.evidence-claims -> visualization.infographic; visualization.chart-design -> reporting.dashboard; eda -> reporting.analytical-report; visualization.chart-design -> reporting.analytical-report; and model-assessment.evidence-claims -> reporting.analytical-report.

c07.data-foundations.structured-data.schema-mapping -> c07.data-foundations.structured-data.serialization is not necessary as written: both dependent probes receive an already mapped record or collection, so neither requires extracting supported facts, covering required fields, or omitting unsupported fields. The entry adds only CSV quoting, which is minimal but does not build on the prerequisite's full outcome.

c07.data-foundations.eda.data-quality -> c07.data-foundations.eda.summaries has the same handoff defect: the entry receives an audited column and the representative receives clean variables, so neither exercises diagnosis of missingness, duplicates, unit inconsistency, or measurement artifacts. The edge encodes workflow order, not a task-level prerequisite.

c07.data-foundations.eda.summaries -> c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships has no new entry capability: comparing the direction of a difference between two categories is already a group-difference summary. Require a relationship-specific delta such as conditioning, interaction, nonlinear association, or artifact diagnosis.

c07.probability-statistics.probability.events -> c07.probability-statistics.probability.updating is overbroad and poorly isolated. Bayesian updating needs event algebra and conditioning, not the prerequisite's full repeated-trial and limiting-event outcome; the purportedly perfect-test entry is either trivial or contradictory rather than a clean one-concept extension.

c07.probability-statistics.probability.events -> c07.probability-statistics.inference.estimation does not supply sampling distributions, estimator variability, standard errors, or coverage. The entry hides this gap by supplying the standard error, then adds both interval construction and frequentist interpretation. Add an intermediate sampling-distributions capability or change the prerequisite.

c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.controlled-validation -> c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.ab-analysis is not necessary: matched live/killed controls, localization, and orthogonal viability measurements are not required by the A/B entry, which stipulates proper randomization and a validated outcome. A narrower measurement-integrity prerequisite or a randomization-design section would fit.

c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.controlled-validation -> c07.models-time.econometrics.identification is a domain mismatch. The dependent entry adds a pre-period trend check to an estimated panel comparison; it does not use laboratory controls, viability measurements, or mechanism-isolating assays. Econometric design diagnostics need their own prerequisite path.

c07.probability-statistics.inference.estimation -> c07.models-time.forecasting.evaluation contradicts the prerequisite boundary: inference.estimation explicitly excludes prediction intervals for future time points, while the dependent entry immediately requires a forecast uncertainty interval. Forecast-distribution or predictive-uncertainty modeling is an unmodeled capability.

c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.chart-design -> c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.scientific leaves too many capabilities unmodeled. Even the entry requires phase-plane direction, initial-condition semantics, and singular-region reasoning; the representative additionally requires nonlinear ODE integration and stability/attractor analysis. Chart encoding mastery gives little chance of solving it.

c07.data-foundations.structured-data.schema-mapping -> c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.dashboard is unnecessary: the entry receives a defined metric, and the representative receives a typed metric model. Neither extracts facts into required, optional, nested, repeated, or enumerated fields, so the prerequisite's full outcome is not used.
other_findings: Discovery evidence is severely imbalanced. The 16 selected tasks provide repeated support for schema conversion (c07-d04, d08, d12, d16), elementary probability/statistics (d02, d06, d07, d10, d14), domain-specific model criticism (d01, d05, d11), one laboratory-control task (d13), and one phase portrait (d15). They provide no direct generation evidence for ordinary EDA, dashboards, reports, infographics, A/B analysis, biostatistics, epidemiology, econometric identification, or forecast construction. This is an evidence gap, not by itself a defect in guidepost-derived sections.

The permitted held-out C07 probes cover only descriptive dispersion (eval-02), matrix row aggregation and sorting (eval-05), stationary autoregressive shock decay (eval-09), and p-value decisions (eval-10). They give limited routing evidence for summaries, temporal structure, and hypothesis testing, and none for most other leaves. No retrieval similarities or competing-section mappings were supplied, so mapping stability cannot be evaluated.

eval-05 is best treated as a close C01/C07 boundary probe: sorting matrix rows by their sums is primarily implementation and collection manipulation, not evidence that C07 needs a matrix-programming section. Likewise, c07-d03 on double-slit geometry and c07-d09 on PCR amplicon length are out-of-subject discovery noise rather than uncovered C07 capabilities.
AAII 4.3 was treated as metadata-only and no individual AAII example was used as coverage, routing, or generation evidence.

Structurally, all 42 sections have one entry and one representative probe, all parents resolve, and all five guidepost families are recognizable. Of the 16 internal-node representative tasks, 15 provide plausible cross-child synthesis: data-foundations, structured-data, EDA, probability-statistics, probability, inference, experiments-health, experimental-design, population-health, models-time, model-assessment, econometrics, forecasting, visualization, and reporting. Only visualization-reporting has the forced cross-child package described above.
rubric_changes: Add a cross-subject containment check for discovery-driven branches: a selected task may justify a section only when its decisive operation belongs to the subject, not merely because its surface data or output format resembles the subject. Otherwise record it as a routing non-member.

Require a prerequisite-edge audit table with three explicit judgments for every edge: why the full prerequisite outcome is necessary, which part of the representative task exercises it, and the single new operation introduced by the entry task. Treat receiving an already cleaned, mapped, validated, or modeled artifact as pipeline ordering rather than prerequisite use.

Strengthen the internal-node synthesis rule across subjects by requiring one natural shared artifact, question, or decision for all child contributions. Merely concatenating one deliverable from every child should fail even when every child is mentioned.
